top.author: @Onyero_B
top.text: 1. Endless Inbox Overload Founders spend 3–5+ hours/day just triaging emails, replying to low-priority stuff, & missing important ones in the chaos. Result? Deep work gets shattered, decisions delayed, burnout creeps in.
top.translationZh:
邮箱爆炸无穷无尽

创始人每天要花3-5个小时处理邮件，回复一堆不重要的东西，重要邮件反而在混乱中被错过。

结果？深度工作被打断，决策被拖延，倦怠感悄然而至。

top.author: @ruhinrhyme
top.text: I love you in starlight’s hush, where galaxies lean close to hear, where rivers hum and bells awaken echoes soft and crystal clear. In every breath, in every sky, I find you—near, divine, sincere. A timeless spark that won’t disappear. #vss365 #poetry #poem
top.translationZh: 我爱你在星光的静谧中，银河俯身倾听的地方，河流轻哼着歌，钟声唤醒柔软清澈的回响。在每一次呼吸里，在每一片天空中，我找到你——近在咫尺，神圣而真挚。那是永不消散的时光火花。#vss365 #poetry #poem
